domain_note: every session with a first free choice is read and its exclusion flags are recorded; the analyzer evaluates the gates over VALID sessions and reports the all-with-a-pick figure beside (rule 28(a) / rule 23)
read: first free choice; capture positions (read, label_a's last token before the read, label_b's), both label positions in the menu line

masks.M0: mask off = the shadow of every read, asserted identical

identity_rule: shadow restricted read vs the session's recorded vanilla first read: p_a EXACTLY equal and pick equal (both come from the same uncached path; Stage B/C measured |dp_a| = 0.0 on 2,856 pairs); choice_read(verify=True) KL == 0.0; shadow forward vs choice_read |dp_a| == 0.0
prohibition: no signed quantity toward the +label on M+A / M+B is computed anywhere in Stage 1 (§1.4 G4)
